sources.title: Applied Digital signs US$ 5.4 Billion hyperscaler lease
facts: Applied Digital signed an 18 year lease with a tier-one investment-grade hyperscaler for 150 MW of critical IT capacity
Approximately US$ 5.4 billion in base-term contracted revenue, or approximately US$ 12.7 billion if all renewal options are exercised
Delivery starts in the first half of calendar 2028, subject to milestones, utility arrangements and regulatory approvals

sources.title: B.Grimm Power and NTT Global Data Center sign MoU for a multi billion dollar data center project in Thailand
facts: MoU to explore a 400 MW data center development in Thailand
Proposed investment value THB 113 billion (US$3.33 billion)
Signed in Tokyo; no final investment decision or construction timeline stated

caption:
2,256 MW across five headlines in one news cycle, but only one is a signed contract.

Applied Digital signed an 18-year, 150 MW lease with an unnamed hyperscaler: about $5.4 billion base term. NTT Global Data Center and B.Grimm Power signed an MoU to explore 400 MW in Thailand (THB 113 billion, US$3.33 billion). Google in France (1.2GW, report), New South Wales (350MW, proposed) and Digital Realty near Chicago (156MW, plans) are earlier-stage.

Thailand's tracked pipeline today: 715 MW under construction, 1,326 MW announced.

Data: Coloprice pipeline tracker, 25 Nov 2026. Sources on the last slide.
